object.name: evi_onepole
object.digest: Linear trapezoidal integrated onepole filter with simultaneous outputs for lowpass, allpass and highpass
object.description: Three matched onepole filters in Lowpass, Allpass and Highpass types at three independent outputs. An efficient workhorse onepole for all generic patching needs.

inlets.name: hz
inlets.digest: We have a choice of frequency input in Hz (default) or normalised 0..1, depending on the @prewarp attribute. Optional smoothing (@smooth attribute) is default off.

outlets.name: 6db
outlets.digest: Lowpass. All outputs are from the same filter.

outlets.name: 6db
outlets.digest: Allpass. All outputs are from the same filter.

outlets.name: 6db
outlets.digest: Highpass. All outputs are from the same filter.

attributes.name: prewarp
attributes.description: If on (defualt), the second inlet expects frequency in Hz and g coefficient warping is performed internally. If off, the second inlet expects a normalised g coefficient 0..1 and this is passed on directly to the filter internally.

attributes.name: smooth
attributes.description: Smoothing time of the internal g coefficient (via the second inlet). If 0, smoothing is CPU-off.
